name: Ninjacart
one_liner: Ninjacart connects farmers directly to fresh produce retailers, wholesalers, and traders through a digital supply chain and credit network.
what_you_sell: Fresh produce B2B supply chain fulfillment, agricultural trade marketplace, and trade credit services.
target_group: Ninjacart sells to fresh produce retailers, agricultural traders, and food wholesalers in India. These range from small local grocery shop owners to regional produce distribution businesses. A good prospect is a business dealing in fresh fruits and vegetables that deals with daily procurement inefficiencies, price volatility, or supply chain wastage.
who_uses_it: Farmers, fresh produce shop owners, production traders, wholesalers, importers, and exporters.
who_pays_for_it: Fresh produce retailers, wholesalers, traders, importers, and exporters who buy produce or use fulfillment and credit services.
who_buys_it: Fresh produce retailers, food wholesalers, and agricultural traders.
_claims_to_check: Implies it offers lower costs to retailers while simultaneously giving higher prices to farmers.
Implies nationwide scale and supply chain coverage across India.
Implies a leadership position in fruit and vegetable supply chains, particularly in South Indian cities.
Claims to offer accessible trade financing and credit to all types of agri businesses.
_note: Fill in sender and cannot_claim, then set reviewed to true. Nothing downstream will run until you do. See _claims_to_check for what the tool noticed your site implies.
